meta.parties: Induwati Dissanayake v. Don Alwis Appuhamy

rules.statement: A person who enters into possession of land subject to a fidei commissum and puts up buildings thereon, on an agreement with the fiduciary to pay rent for occupation and receive compensation when required by the fiduciary, is not entitled after the interest of the fiduciary has ceased to claim compensation from the fideicommissary and retain the property until payment.
rules.supporting_quote: "a person who enters into possession of land which is subject to a fidei commissum and puts up buildings thereon, on an agreement with the fiduciary to pay rent for the occupation of the premises and to receive compensation for the buildings whenever the premises are required by the fiduciary, is not entitled, after the interest of the fiduciary has ceased, to claim compensation from the fideicommissary and to retain the property until the payment of such compensation."
